description: Australian Signals Directorate Essential Eight cybersecurity mitigation strategies at Maturity Level 2

domains.description: Eight essential mitigation strategies to protect against cyber threats

requirements.requirement_text: Application control is implemented on workstations and servers to restrict the execution of executables, software libraries, scripts, installers, compiled HTML, HTML applications and control panel applets to an approved set. Application control rulesets are validated on an annual or more frequent basis.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Application control is implemented on workstations
Application control is implemented on internet-facing servers
Application control restricts executables, software libraries, scripts, installers, compiled HTML, HTML applications and control panel applets
Microsoft's recommended application blocklist is implemented
Application control rulesets are validated annually

requirements.requirement_text: Patches, updates or vendor mitigations for security vulnerabilities in internet-facing services are applied within two weeks of release. Patches, updates or vendor mitigations for security vulnerabilities in office productivity suites, web browsers and their extensions, email clients, PDF software, and security products are applied within one month of release.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Internet-facing services are patched within two weeks
Office productivity suites are patched within one month
Web browsers and extensions are patched within one month
Email clients are patched within one month
PDF software is patched within one month
Security products are patched within one month
Vulnerability scanner is used at least fortnightly

requirements.requirement_text: Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate users to their organisation's online services that process, store or communicate sensitive data. Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate users to third-party online services that process, store or communicate sensitive data.
maturity_level_2_criteria: MFA is used for VPNs
MFA is used for RDP and other remote access
MFA is used for all users when accessing internet-facing services
MFA is used for third-party services storing sensitive data
MFA uses either: something users have and know, or something users have that is unlocked by something users know or are

requirements.requirement_text: Web browsers are configured to block or disable support for Flash content, web advertisements and Java from the internet. Web browsers are hardened using ASD or vendor hardening guidance.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Web browsers do not process Java from the internet
Web browsers do not process web advertisements from the internet
Internet Explorer 11 is disabled or removed
Web browsers are hardened using ASD/vendor guidance
Microsoft Office is configured to disable Flash content
Microsoft Office is hardened using ASD/vendor guidance

requirements.requirement_text: Requests for privileged access to systems and applications are validated when first requested. Privileged accounts are prevented from accessing the internet, email and web services. Privileged users use separate privileged and unprivileged operating environments.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Privileged access requests are validated on first request
Privileged accounts cannot access internet, email, web services
Privileged users use separate privileged and unprivileged environments
Unprivileged accounts cannot logon to privileged environments
Privileged accounts (excluding local admin) cannot logon to unprivileged environments

requirements.requirement_text: Patches, updates or vendor mitigations for security vulnerabilities in operating systems of internet-facing services are applied within two weeks of release. Patches, updates or vendor mitigations for security vulnerabilities in operating systems of workstations, servers and network devices are applied within one month of release.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Internet-facing service OS patched within two weeks
Workstation OS patched within one month
Server OS patched within one month
Network device OS/firmware patched within one month
Operating systems no longer supported by vendors are replaced
Vulnerability scanner is used at least fortnightly

requirements.requirement_text: Microsoft Office macros are disabled for users who do not have a demonstrated business requirement. Microsoft Office macros in files originating from the internet are blocked. Microsoft Office macro antivirus scanning is enabled.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Microsoft Office macros are disabled for users without business need
Microsoft Office macros from the internet are blocked
Microsoft Office macro antivirus scanning is enabled
Microsoft Office macro security settings cannot be changed by users

requirements.requirement_text: Backups of important data, software and configuration settings are performed and retained in accordance with business continuity requirements. Backups are synchronised to enable restoration to a common point in time. Backups are retained in a secure and resilient manner.
maturity_level_2_criteria: Backups of important data, software, config are performed and retained
Backups are synchronised to common point in time
Backups are stored offline or in a manner where they cannot be modified/deleted
Backups are tested as part of disaster recovery exercises
Unprivileged accounts cannot access backups of other accounts
Unprivileged accounts cannot modify or delete backups
